name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2065: Three things. ONE: 17 of his 24 vault rows rendered AI sighting time UNKNOWN because an ungrounded sighting carries a recording id and no ts - but a recording id contains its own start time, so the instant is unknown while the WINDOW is not. They now read seen in a recording from DATE and name the recording. Reported as a range, never rounded to a point. TWO: v2062 called frame_authority the one deletion authority and wired only the frame prune to it, leaving reel_retention - the deleter that removes WHOLE REELS - reading its own private copy of the same two stores. They agreed on his tree that day, which is when a duplicate is cheapest to remove and hardest to notice. THREE: a v2053 fixture picked the first existing directory from a list containing node_modules, which is refused EARLY by the NEVER list, so once playwright-report was gone the tracked-file check under test was never reached. It was green or red depending on which build artifacts happened to be on disk.
